description: Check whether AI crawlers can reach a website: OpenAI's OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User and GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot and 17 more. Use this when someone asks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews or Copilot can read or cite their site, why AI answers ignore their pages, or what to change in robots.txt. Reads robots.txt (and checks its health), the sitemap (which published pages each crawler may not read) and the homepage's HTML, and requests the homepage once with each crawler's user agent. Returns a verdict per AI product, the exact fix for each real problem, or a plain "nothing to fix" (private areas like /api or /dashboard are meant to be disallowed).

domain.description: Website domain or URL, for example example.com or https://www.example.com/pricing
